field.name: commission_type
field.invisible: commission_is_explicit_amount or commission_is_explicit_percentage or not commission_use_fixed_amount

field.name: x_comision_fija_producto
field.invisible: (commission_type != 'percentage' and not commission_is_explicit_percentage) or not commission_use_fixed_percentage or commission_is_explicit_amount
field.help: Si colocas un porcentaje mayor a 0, se ignorará la matriz de comisiones y se usará este porcentaje.

field.name: commission_fixed_amount
field.invisible: (commission_type != 'fixed' and not commission_is_explicit_amount) or not commission_use_fixed_amount or commission_is_explicit_percentage
field.help: Monto en dólares que se pagará por cada unidad vendida.
